drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is our proposed first-round redline. We clarified the payment mechanics and added customary exceptions to the confidentiality provision. The settlement amount remains bracketed for discussion. Please let us know your proposed figure and any comments on the revisions.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the settlement amount of [Settlement Amount] in U.S. dollars (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date of this Agreement.

2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims that Plaintiff asserted or could have asserted against Defendant arising from the matters resolved by this Agreement, through the date Plaintiff executes this Agreement. This release does not limit either party’s right to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its attorneys, accountants, insurers, and other professional advisers who are bound by confidentiality obligations; as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement; or as required by law, regulation, court order, or governmental process. Where legally permitted, a party required to make a disclosure shall give the other party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment.
